title: The 15 month wait is gone

lines.say: You own a condo and want to move into an HDB resale flat. You used to wait 15 months. Not any more.
lines.cap: you used to *wait 15 months.* not any more

lines.say: On 27 July 2026, HDB removed the 15 month wait out with immediate effect.
It applies to private property owners, and former owners, buying a non subsidised resale flat.
The condition: you buy without an HDB loan.
HDB said resale prices had moderated for several quarters and were stabilising.
For right sizers, that means one move, not a 15 month gap in rented housing.
Thinking of right sizing? Comment CHECK and we'll map out your steps.

source: HDB, 27 Jul 2026. Other eligibility rules apply.
caption:
Own a condo and want to move into an HDB resale flat? You no longer need to wait 15 months. 🏠

On 27 July 2026, HDB removed the 15 month wait out with immediate effect. It applies to private property owners, and former owners, buying a non subsidised resale flat without an HDB loan.

For right sizers, that means one move, not a 15 month gap in rented housing.

Thinking of right sizing? Comment CHECK and we'll map out your steps 👇

Other HDB eligibility rules still apply.
